## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) and is a valid Conventional Commit — header <= 72 chars, no trailing period.
- [ ] Branch history is clean: rebased on the latest `main`, fixup/WIP commits squashed.
- [ ] `npm test` (in `vscode-extension`) and `mvn verify` (in `fhir-mapbuilder-validation`) pass locally.
- [ ] If this bumps FHIR or Matchbox: the `requireSameVersions` enforcer rule on `org.hl7.fhir.*` passes (`mvn verify` in `fhir-mapbuilder-validation`).
- [ ] If this bumps Matchbox: the bundled version stated in `vscode-extension/README.md` matches `health.matchbox.version` in `pom.xml`.
- [ ] No `CHANGELOG` entry added — the changelog and version bump are generated by release automation.
